findings.heading: Github issues / Issues en Github
findings.proposition: The English sentence carries a working cross-reference to the Collaboration and Github chapter, written as a markdown link [Collaboration and Github](collaboration.qmd); the Spanish writes [Colaboración y Github]{#version-control-and-collaboration-with-git-and-github}, which is span-attribute syntax, not link syntax, so no cross-reference exists in the translation.
findings.reader_consequence: A Spanish reader is told to read more about storing work on Github 'on the page Colaboración y Github', but the text renders as plain unlinked words. The reader cannot reach the chapter and has no file name or URL to find it by.

findings.heading: The reprex package / El paquete reprex
findings.proposition: The English says the arguments and possible variations are documented in the reprex documentation (a separate resource, given as a link labelled 'documentation'); the Spanish says they can be read 'en esta página' ('on this page'), locating that material inside the handbook page itself.
findings.reader_consequence: A Spanish reader looks for a fuller account of the reprex arguments on the current handbook page, where it does not exist, instead of going to the reprex package documentation. The reader may conclude the page is incomplete rather than consulting the external reference.
